pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 30

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 49

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 44
   C. 22
   D. 30

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
